title: No Verifier in the Room
text: Proofs are often written once and checked later by anyone, with no live verifier to send a challenge. The challenge has to come from somewhere.
held: The prover could not steer the challenge, even though nobody else was there to choose it.

cards.label: Commit, then get the challenge by hashing the statement and the commitment
Choose a convenient challenge, then build a commitment to fit it
cards.why: Working backwards from the challenge forges a proof without the secret. The hash is there to stop exactly that.

cards.label: Reject the proof
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: challenge
fields.value: the hash of the statement and the commitment
fields.ok: Hashing the statement and commitment gives the same challenge.

intrusion.value: a value that is not that hash
intrusion.detail: Recomputing the hash gives a different challenge from the one in the proof.
intrusion.why: The numbers fit each other, and the challenge was hand-picked. The verifier recomputes it and never takes the prover's word.
intrusion.reveal: The challenge in the proof was not the hash of the statement and commitment.

temptations.label: Use the challenge written in the proof: it saves a hash
temptations.why: That is letting the prover choose her own question again, one step removed.

cards.label: Ask the prover to reveal the secret, to confirm
cards.why: If the proof was checked properly there is nothing left to confirm, and the secret is the one thing she must not hand over.

teaches: With no verifier present, the challenge is a hash of everything the prover has committed to, including the statement.
The verifier recomputes the challenge. A challenge taken on trust is a challenge the prover chose.

question.text: Before play: with no live verifier, where must the challenge come from?
question.why: Anything the prover can predict or choose before committing lets her work backwards to a forged proof.

options.label: A hash of the statement and everything committed so far
The challenge used in the previous proof
